name: ntasks
description: A task hub for people and AI agents, on Cloudflare Workers and D1.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @ntasks/web run build && pnpm --filter @ntasks/api run dev

NTASKS_ORIGIN.description: The address people and agents reach Ntasks at, with no path or trailing slash: `https://` followed by the Worker name and your `workers.dev` subdomain, such as `https://ntasks.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev`. `https` is required.

AUTH_SECRET.description: A random value of at least 32 characters. Make one with `openssl rand -base64 32`. It signs session cookies and sign-in state, and encrypts stored GitHub tokens and agents' client secrets.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: The client ID of the GitHub OAuth app the owner signs in through. [Register the app](https://github.com/notice-cx/Ntasks/blob/main/docs/sign-in.md#register-the-github-oauth-app) for this Worker's address first.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: A client secret generated for that GitHub OAuth app.

OWNER_GITHUB_IDS.description: The numeric GitHub user ids that may sign in, separated by commas, such as `1001`. `https://api.github.com/users/<login>` shows an account's id.
